name: itsees
description: Control the Itsees desktop pet's journeys, progress, postcards, and souvenirs from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Travel with your Itsees pet from Codex
interface.longDescription: Use natural language to check your Itsees desktop pet, choose unlocked destinations and pack items, start or recall a journey, continue partial progress, directly display returned postcard images, and browse souvenirs and travel history. The plugin shares local travel state with the existing Electron app.
defaultPrompt: 看看我的桌宠现在旅行到哪里了
列出可去的目的地并帮我安排一次旅行
看看最近带回了哪些明信片和纪念品
